deployment_topology.control_plane: Single Go process on Windows; sole business scheduler and transaction authority
deployment_topology.ui: React static assets served by control plane
deployment_topology.authoritative_database: Local SQLite, WAL, foreign keys, reliable sync, busy timeout
deployment_topology.worker: Windows delegated execution and journal only; no business dispatch queue
deployment_topology.verifier: Independent constrained identity; server owns final atomic acceptance
deployment_topology.release_supervisor: Separate stable privilege boundary, implemented in later phase

reopen_rule: New ADR and explicit new authorization; W01 counters are retained
